description: Book German e-invoices into DATEV: XRechnung (UBL and CII), ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDFs and Peppol BIS invoices become a DATEV EXTF v700 Buchungsstapel. One booking per VAT rate with the BU key (19% = 9, 7% = 8, reverse charge 46 / 94, intra-EU acquisition 19) for incoming invoices, or DATEV automatic revenue accounts for outgoing ones; credit notes flip Soll / Haben; due date in Belegfeld 2; buyer VAT ID in EU-Land u. UStID. Duplicates and non-EUR invoices are listed, not booked. Up to 100 invoices per call. Returns bookings JSON + EXTF base64. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/einvoice-to-datev.

clientNo.description: DATEV Mandantennummer for the file header (optional)

consultantNo.description: DATEV Beraternummer for the file header (optional)

expenseAccount.description: Expense account of incoming invoices (default 4980 SKR03 / 6850 SKR04)

fileName.description: Optional file name for xml / fileContent

files.description: E-invoices: [{fileName, fileContent (base64 of .xml, ZUGFeRD .pdf or .zip)}] (empty = built-in sample month)

xml.description: Or one e-invoice as XML text

name: einvoice_to_datev
title: E-Invoice to DATEV API - XRechnung, ZUGFeRD & Peppol to EXTF Buchungsstapel (SKR03 / SKR04)
